recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source edit is needed; future wording changes to these codes should be made in the terminology source of truth rather than duplicated in core.
issue_request: FHIR-13025 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request asking to add relapse to the Condition.clinicalStatus code set, clarify recurrence, and make recurrence and relapse children of active.
initial_application: Commit 8da21fd1e42462d6253f4ce91b89c267bb415801 explicitly applied #13025 by adding relapse under active, replacing the recurrence definition, and updating the Condition.clinicalStatus short display in the then-current Condition source.
additional_context: Condition is active in source/fhir.ini. Current core binds Condition.clinicalStatus to ValueSet/condition-clinical, which includes all codes from the THO condition-clinical code system. Later FHIR-26464 refined the code definitions, and UTG/THO migration removed the code system definition from core source. An April 2017 Zulip thread confirms Patient Care approved GF#13025 for recurrence and relapse as active children.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current active Condition source and referenced THO code system already contain relapse and recurrence under active with the later approved definitions.

related_jiras.note: Applied in the same historical commit but concerned controlled/poorly-controlled clinicalStatus codes, a separate proposal outside the seed decision.
